topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I can't believe they're going ahead with this without even talking to me! Here I am, trying to maintain a good relationship with everyone around, and my neighbor decides to put up a fence like it’s no big deal. It's not just a fence; it’s a statement. A statement that my privacy, my peace, my carefully cultivated space doesn’t matter. Well, two can play that game. I’ve got my plans too, and they’re about to find out that fences don’t just make good neighbors; they can also make quite the spectacle. I’ll show them what it means to be considerate of the community. This isn’t over.
